task.specification:
Input is a canonical absolute POSIX path (no . or ..). Return proper ancestor paths starting at / and ending at its parent; root has no ancestors. The returned array may contain up to 128 items.
Shared domain: Numbers are signed 64-bit integers; all required intermediate and final arithmetic fits i64. Arrays contain at most 64 items and strings are ASCII with at most 256 bytes, unless an explicit task exception says otherwise. Whitespace means space, TAB, LF, FF or CR. JSON booleans and null retain their normal types.

A trusted wrapper reads one JSON line and writes the returned JSON value. Do not read files, use the network, spawn processes or access tests. Inputs satisfy the stated contract.
